explanation: It covers less than half a square kilometre, which makes it the smallest independent state in the world. Its head of state is the Pope.

claims.text: Vatican City is an independent state that lies entirely within the city of Rome.
San Marino is surrounded by Italy but lies far from Rome, Monaco borders France, and Andorra lies between France and Spain.
Vatican City covers less than half a square kilometre.
Vatican City is the smallest independent state in the world by area.
The Pope is the head of state of Vatican City.
